row:
Welcome to Blue Daily Elephant Care Sanctuary channel, our elephant sanctuary is not only to make you happy with these domesticated elephants in a truly beautiful nature environment, but it is also giving a good chance to support the hill tribes and local Thai farmers who live in the villages nearby our elephant sanctuary, we buy some agricultural products from them such as : Napier grasses, sweet corn stumps, rice grains, tamarinds, sugar canes, bananas, and local shoulder bags.

Visit our website: https://www.bluedailyelephantcare.com/
Our facebook fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/bluedailyelephantcaresanctuary
